普通样式和逐行盒：阴影向右下偏移；整体背景盒：控制底板留白，不另画文字阴影。出厂: Normal and per-line box styles: offset the shadow down and right. Full background box: adjust padding without a separate text shadow. Default: 0.5. Both use the background color below.
控制底板颜色的透明度；颜色选「不设置」时使用黑色，透明度仍按此值。逐行盒的描边盒: Set background opacity. An unset color uses black with this opacity. The outline box in per-line mode uses the outline color.
服务器地址在本机或局域网（localhost、私有地址、.local 或不带点的: Use LAN settings for local or LAN servers (localhost, private addresses, .local, or hostnames without a dot), and WAN settings otherwise. The address is checked when playback starts. Size limits forward buffering; backward buffering uses half as much. The smaller size or duration limit applies. Increasing these values uses more memory and does not increase network speed.
服务器在本机或局域网时使用: Used for local or LAN servers
服务器地址不在本机或局域网时使用: Used for servers outside the local network
音轨为外语时显示: When audio is in a foreign language
设置保存失败，修改仍在本次运行中生效；请重试保存。: Settings could not be saved. Your changes still apply for this session; please try saving again.
只有「外部 mpv.exe」后端需要它。访问令牌通过核验进程身份的管道传递，不放: Required only for the external mpv.exe backend. Access tokens use an identity-verified process pipe, never command-line arguments or temporary files. Playback stops if a secure channel cannot be established. Choose a trusted mpv.exe; malicious software running as the same Windows user may still steal credentials.
关掉后不读取或上报进度，也不提供客户端控制；安全起播和退出仍需管道: When off, playback progress is not read or reported and client controls are unavailable. Secure startup and exit still require a pipe.
用程序里内置的播放器播，还是调起独立的 mpv.exe 来播。: Choose the built-in player or launch a separate mpv.exe.
读取指定文件中的音视频参数，覆盖本程序的常规播放设置；窗口与播放控制仍由 Mom: Read audio and video options from the selected file, overriding normal playback settings. Momoka still manages the window and playback controls.
选择并粘贴 mpv.conf 的完整路径: Paste the full path to mpv.conf
支持带引号的路径。文件内的 ~~/ 指向配置所在目录；不自动载入该目录的 inp: Quoted paths are supported. In the file, ~~/ refers to its directory. input.conf and scripts in that directory are not loaded automatically.
集成模式不读取外部配置文件，这一项固定关闭；切成独占模式后可以选择。: Integrated mode does not read external configuration files, so this option stays off. Switch to standalone mode to enable it.
内置播放器可用；只有独占模式会读取这个文件，下次播放生效。: Available with the built-in player. Only standalone mode reads this file. Applies to the next playback.
播放器右键菜单 →「截屏」里三档截图存到这儿，文件名是片名、播放时间和序号。留空: Save all three screenshot types from the player's context menu here. Filenames include the title, playback time, and sequence number. Leave blank to use the screenshots folder in the data directory. Changes apply from the next screenshot, including during playback.
装机默认 png。选 WebP 出现无损、质量与压缩，选 JPG 出现质量；其余: Default: PNG. WebP offers lossless, quality, and compression options; JPG offers quality. Other formats use mpv defaults.
默认关。关着或格式不支持时，mpv 把画面转成 sRGB 再落盘，HDR 片源的: Off by default. If disabled or unsupported by the format, mpv converts the image to sRGB before saving, including screenshots from HDR sources.
画质一点不损，文件大得多；开启时下面两行收起来。: Preserve image quality with much larger files. Hides the next two options when enabled.
越高越接近原画面、文件越大。: Higher values preserve more detail and create larger files.
越高编码越慢，也影响画质。: Higher values encode more slowly and may also affect quality.
越高越接近原画面；mpv 自己的默认是 90。: Higher values preserve more detail. mpv's default is 90.
播放器右键菜单 →「截屏」里三档截图的落点与画质。改完当场生效：正播着的那部从下: Save location and quality for all three screenshot types in the player's context menu. Changes apply from the next screenshot, including during playback.
当前播放的截图选项未完全更新: Some screenshot options could not be applied to the current playback
向服务器汇报播放进度: Report playback progress to the server
关闭后服务器不再记录本次播放进度: When off, the server does not record progress for this playback.
从服务器保存的位置继续: Resume from the server's saved position
关掉后每次都从片头放起: When off, always start from the beginning.
一集放完自动接下一集，本季放完退出播放: Continue with the next episode; leave playback after the final episode in the season.
起播时自动进全屏，不用再按 F。只在起播那一下：连播的下一集不会把你顶出全屏，按: Enter fullscreen at the start without pressing F. Applies only when starting playback: the next episode preserves fullscreen, and does not reenter it after you leave with F.
放到这个百分比以上，这一条就算看过: Mark an item as watched after this percentage.
类型为动画、发行公司带腾讯、哔哩哔哩、优酷或爱奇艺的片子单独按这一档算，不吃上面: A separate threshold for animation distributed by Tencent, Bilibili, Youku, or iQIYI. The threshold above does not apply to these items.
优先用服务器识别出的片头片尾（Emby 的章节标记、Jellyfin 的媒体段、: Prefer server markers (Emby chapters, Jellyfin media segments, or Plex markers). Missing marker types fall back to file chapters. Server markers win when both describe the same section.
→ 键跳这么多秒: Seconds to seek with the right arrow key.
← 键跳这么多秒: Seconds to seek with the left arrow key.
↑ 键跳这么多秒: Seconds to seek with the up arrow key.
↓ 键跳这么多秒: Seconds to seek with the down arrow key.
未指定，跟随服务器默认音轨: Not specified; use the server's default audio track
勾选语言并排序（拖动或箭头换次序），越靠上越优先。空着就是「跟随服务器默认音轨」: Select languages and reorder them by dragging or using the arrows. Higher entries have priority. Leave empty to use the server default. The Other subtitles fallback also means any other language when used for audio. Applies to the next playback.
语言选出「哪几条是这个语言」之后，再按编码／声道里的词挑一遍：优先＝含这个词的排: After selecting a language, rank tracks by codec or channel keywords. Prefer moves matches first; Fallback moves them last but still allows them when nothing else matches; Default has no effect. Presets include Atmos, TrueHD, DTS-HD, DTS, FLAC, 7.1, and 5.1. Add custom keywords and drag to reorder. Format ranking never overrides language priority. Applies to the next playback.
断点续播、进度上报、连播与全屏、看过多少算看完。: Resume, progress reporting, automatic continuation and fullscreen, and the watched threshold.
四颗方向键一次跳多少秒。集成模式与独占模式共用这几个数，屏上印的和按下去的永远对: Seek distances for the four arrow keys. Integrated and standalone modes use the same values shown here.
选哪条音轨：先按语言挑，再在同一语言里按编码与声道挑。: Choose audio by language first, then by codec and channel layout within that language.
一部片子有多个版本（多个文件）时挑哪一版：媒体源按什么次序排，默认播的那一版按文: Choose the default version when an item has multiple files, using media-source order and filename keywords.
一部片子有多个版本（多个文件）时，详情页「媒体源」那一行和播放器「版本」菜单的次: Set version order in media details and the player's version menu. Default uses server order; Newest added first requests each version's added date and puts the newest first. The first version is also the playback default when no filename rule matches. Items with only one version are unaffected. Applies when details reopen or playback next starts.
一部片子有多个版本（多个文件）时，按文件名里的词决定默认播哪一版：越靠上优先级越: Choose the default version using filename keywords, ordered by priority. Prefer moves matching versions first; Fallback moves them last but still allows them if necessary; Default has no effect. Add keywords such as REMUX, 4K, or HDR. Items with only one version are unaffected. Applies to the next playback.
纯文本字幕的样式示意，两行文字可比较逐行盒与整体背景盒。不是 libass 播放: A style preview for text subtitles. Two lines demonstrate per-line and full background boxes. This is not libass output; actual size also depends on the window and subtitle format.
未指定，跟随文件默认字幕: Not specified; use the file's default subtitles
勾选语言并排序（拖动或箭头换次序），越靠上越优先。「其他字幕」是一个预设项，代表: Select languages and reorder them by dragging or using the arrows. Higher entries have priority. Other subtitles accepts any other language as a fallback. An empty list follows only an explicitly marked default track, subject to display mode, and shows nothing when none exists. Applies to the next playback.
语言选出「哪几条是中文」之后，再按标题里的词挑一遍：越靠上优先级越高；优先＝含这: After choosing Chinese subtitle tracks by language, rank them by title keywords. Prefer moves matches first; Fallback moves them last but still allows them if necessary; Default has no effect. Add custom keywords. Selecting Simplified Chinese also treats tracks marked Traditional Chinese as fallbacks. Applies to the next playback.
没有匹配语言时使用默认字幕: Use default subtitles when no language matches
只回退服务器指定或文件标记的默认字幕，不再按标题改选别的轨道；没有默认轨就不显示: Fall back only to a server-designated or file-marked default track, without choosing another by title. Show nothing if none exists. To accept any language, add Other subtitles at the end of the language list. Does not affect an empty language list.
ASS/SSA 字幕自带字体和颜色，默认由它自己说了算，下面这些外观只对纯文本字: ASS/SSA subtitles control their own fonts and colors by default. These options normally affect only plain text (SRT/VTT). Forced overrides may break ASS positioning and effects. Bitmap subtitles (PGS/VOBSUB) cannot change font or text color.
列出这台机器装的字体和程序自带的字体，可搜索；mpv 认的是字体族名，不是文件路: Search installed and bundled fonts. mpv uses font family names, not file paths.
字幕文字的大小，出厂 50；mpv 自己是 38: Subtitle text size. Momoka default: 50; mpv default: 38.
在字号之上再乘一次，100 就是不缩放。ASS/SSA 字幕不用「强制」也认这一: Multiply the font size; 100 means no scaling. Also affects ASS/SSA without forced overrides, allowing their text to be enlarged.
开了字幕用粗体：字体有真粗体就用真的，没有的由 libmpv 合成: Use a real bold font when available; otherwise libmpv synthesizes it.
HTML 颜色代码（#RRGGBB），点色块从拾色器里挑: HTML color code (#RRGGBB). Click the swatch to choose a color.
文字外那一圈边的宽度，0 就是没有描边。出厂 0.5，mpv 自己是 1.65: Width of the text outline. Zero removes it. Momoka default: 0.5; mpv default: 1.65.
亮画面上最管用的一项。关着的时候只有描边和阴影: Especially useful on bright scenes. When off, only the outline and shadow remain.
只对不是 UTF-8 的文本字幕有意义。选了具体编码就不再自动识别了，所以简体那: Applies only to non-UTF-8 text subtitles. Choosing an encoding disables automatic detection; choosing Simplified Chinese for Big5 subtitles produces unreadable text. Applies to the next playback.
拉伸图形字幕到画面: Stretch bitmap subtitles to the video
画面比 16:9 更宽的电影，把图形字幕（PGS/VOBSUB）拉伸到画面里，免: Fit bitmap subtitles (PGS/VOBSUB) into movies wider than 16:9 so they do not fall outside the image. Applies to the next playback.
挑哪条字幕轨：先按语言，再按标题里的词。勾选语言并排序，越靠上越优先；「其他字幕: Choose subtitles by language first, then title keywords. Higher selected languages have priority; Other subtitles accepts any other language as a fallback. Applies to the next playback.
字幕长什么样。这一组改完立刻作用到正在播的片子；ASS/SSA 字幕要不要被覆盖: Subtitle appearance. Changes apply immediately to current playback. The first option controls whether ASS/SSA styles are overridden.
不是 UTF-8 的老字幕读成乱码时改这里；图形字幕跑到画面外头也在这儿拉回来。: Fix unreadable non-UTF-8 subtitles or bitmap subtitles outside the image. Applies to the next playback.
给包住所有文字行的背景盒上色；不设置时使用黑色，透明度由下一行控制: Color the box around all subtitle lines. Unset uses black; opacity is controlled below.
给逐行盒的阴影上色；描边盒使用描边颜色。不设置时使用黑色: Color the shadow of each line's box; outline boxes use the outline color. Unset uses black.
给文字阴影上色；字幕底板关闭时不画背景盒。不设置时使用黑色: Color the text shadow. No background box is drawn when subtitle background is off. Unset uses black.
当前播放的字幕外观未完全更新: Some subtitle appearance options could not be applied to the current playback
需要功放/电视支持这一格式；直通后音量均衡、下混归一化和音量条都不再作用于这条音: Requires receiver or TV support. Passthrough bypasses volume normalization, downmix normalization, and the volume control for that track.
交给功放原样解码: Send the original bitstream to the receiver for decoding
播放时把声卡占下来、绕过系统混音，声音更原样；代价是放片的时候别的程序出不了声: Use the audio device exclusively and bypass system mixing for unaltered output. Other applications cannot use that device during playback.
正值＝声音推迟，负值＝声音提前；清空输入框不会归零，灰字是仍在生效的值: Positive delays audio; negative advances it. Clearing the box does not reset the value; the placeholder shows the value still in effect.
只对 AC-3 / E-AC-3 音轨有效，而且要片源自带 DRC 信息；DTS: Works only for AC-3/E-AC-3 tracks with DRC metadata. It does not affect DTS, TrueHD, AAC, or FLAC; use Volume normalization for those.
对解码后的音频有效（直通除外），代价是动态范围被压窄；播放器右键菜单里可以当场试: Applies to decoded audio, excluding passthrough, and reduces dynamic range. Compare the three modes immediately in the player's context menu.
多声道下混时防削波：把混音系数整体压到不超载，代价是整体变轻。它不单独抬高对白: Prevent clipping during downmix by reducing overall mixing coefficients. Overall volume becomes lower. It does not specifically boost dialogue; use Volume normalization for that. Applies only when mpv performs the downmix.
声音从哪张声卡出来、几个声道、独占还是共享，以及整体的音画对齐。这一页的改动保存: Select the audio device, channel layout, exclusive or shared output, and global audio/video alignment. Applies to the next playback after saving.
对白太轻、爆炸太响时调这里。这几行对解码后的音频生效，直通的音轨不受影响。: Adjust quiet dialogue and loud effects. Applies to decoded audio; passthrough is unaffected.
把原样码流交给功放或电视解码。直通之后音量均衡、下混归一化和音量条都不再作用于这: Send the original bitstream to a receiver or TV. Volume normalization, downmix normalization, and the volume control do not affect passthrough tracks.
每次打开设置重新读取内置 libmpv 的设备名单，起播前再核对一次；未找到时本: Refresh the built-in libmpv device list whenever settings open, and check it again before playback. A missing device uses the system default for this playback without changing the saved choice. External mpv uses its own device list, with no guaranteed match or fallback. Unplugging a device or an open failure during playback may still cause silence.
主页最上面那张会自己走的大图，剧照铺满整张卡、下面那几排接在它下面。关掉之后这张: Show the automatic full-image carousel at the top of Home, with shelves below it. Turn it off for a page of regular horizontal shelves. Choose its contents using the four options below.
全宽大图是一张整宽轮播；商店版式宽窗左主图、右侧三张推荐，窄窗推荐移到圆点下方。: Full-width uses one image across the page. Store layout shows a main image and three recommendations in wide windows; recommendations move below the dots in narrow windows. Libraries stay below the carousel in Store layout. Switching back restores the preferred position.
顶上那张大图站哪一类；音乐类从不出现在轮播里: Choose the media type for the carousel. Music is never included.
最近添加按服务器记录的入库时间从新到旧；随机挑选拿到的是服务器随手给的一批，回到: Recently added sorts by the server's added date. Random selection uses a server-selected batch that may change when Home is revisited.
一张封面站多少秒再换下一张，指针停在带上的时候不计时: Seconds before the next image. Pauses while the pointer is over the carousel.
媒体库那一排（进各媒体库的入口）摆在主页第一屏的哪儿。「随窗口高度变换」是装机默: Position the library shortcuts on the first Home screen. Automatic follows window height: libraries move into the carousel when the window is short and below it when taller. The other choices fix the position. Without a carousel, the inside-carousel choice is displayed below instead.
主页最上面那条会自己走的大图：摆不摆、哪一版、放哪一类、几张、一张站几秒。: Choose whether the top carousel appears, its layout, media type, count, and interval.
媒体库那一排摆在第一屏的哪儿，以及主页上那几排的次序和显示与否，包括每个媒体库自: Position the library shortcuts and choose the order and visibility of Home shelves, including each library's shelf.
拖动一行或用右边那两颗箭头决定次序，取消勾选就不显示。: Drag a row or use the two arrows to reorder it. Clear its checkbox to hide it.
轮播图开着时「媒体库」固定在第一位、不能挪动。: Libraries stay first and cannot be moved while the carousel is enabled.
展开「媒体库」可选择首页要显示的入口，并调整入口顺序。各库的最近添加可在下方单独: Expand Libraries to select and reorder the Home shortcuts. Each library's recently added shelf can be configured separately below.
页面切换、卡片悬停等界面动效，改完立即生效；开启时仍遵循 Windows 动画设: Page transitions, card hover effects, and other animations. Applies immediately and respects Windows animation settings.
媒体库一页列多少个，翻页按这个数走: Number of items per library page.
开启后这一页每一条设置下面的小字说明都收起来，只留标签和控件；想看某条是什么意思: Hide the smaller explanations below every setting, leaving labels and controls. Turn off to show the explanations again.
选择模式、透明效果、主题色、UI 动画、隐藏功能下方说明和媒体库分页。: Appearance mode, transparency, theme, animations, descriptions, and library pagination.
深色使用下面选中的主题色板；浅色使用系统浅色配色；跟随系统会随 Windows: Dark uses the selected palette below; Light uses the system light palette; Follow system switches automatically with Windows app appearance.
窗口、卡片和输入框显示半透明；关掉后这些表面全部落成实色，窗口的 Mica 也一: Use translucent windows, cards, and input surfaces. Turn off for solid surfaces, including window Mica. Applies immediately.
指针在封面上停稳、面板撑开后，如果服务器里这条条目有本地预告片，就自动播放它；只: When the cover preview expands, play a local trailer provided by the server. Remote YouTube trailers keep a static image on hover.
悬停面板里的预告片默认不出声；关掉后按服务器音轨播放。: Hover trailers are muted by default. Turn off to play the server's audio track.
播完从头循环，直到指针离开悬停面板。: Loop from the start until the pointer leaves the preview.
商店宽版式的详情页右上角自动播放预告片（本地或远程）；关掉后只显示背景图，预告片: Automatically play local or remote trailers in the top-right corner of Store details pages. Turn off to show the background image; the trailer button remains available.
封面悬停与详情页里的预告片播放方式。悬停只播放服务器本地预告片。: Trailer behavior for cover previews and details pages. Hover previews play only local trailers from the server.
登录 Windows 之后自动打开 Momoka；关掉就从系统的启动项里撤掉。改: Open Momoka after signing in to Windows. Turn off to remove its startup entry. Applies immediately without restarting. This is a system startup entry, visible in Task Manager, and is not stored in the settings file.
没能关掉开机自启：系统拒绝了这次改动，本程序仍会在登录后启动。: Could not disable startup: Windows rejected the change, so Momoka will still start after sign-in.
没能打开开机自启：系统拒绝了这次改动，本程序不会在登录后启动。: Could not enable startup: Windows rejected the change, so Momoka will not start after sign-in.
没能确认开机自启改动已完成，请在系统启动项中核对。: Could not confirm the startup change. Check the Windows startup apps list.
连接 MoviePilot 后，在侧边栏显示日历入口。: Show the calendar shortcut in the sidebar when connected to MoviePilot.
接上你自己的 MoviePilot，之后就能在库里查缺集、订阅和搜资源。协议选: Connect your own MoviePilot to find missing episodes, subscribe, and search for resources. Choose HTTP or HTTPS, enter its host and API port (default 3001), not the web interface port. You can also choose whether AniBT appears.
这是一个可选的服务：接上之后，这个程序能替你去 MoviePilot 那边找片、: An optional service for searching, subscriptions, and missing episodes through your MoviePilot. Momoka also works without it.
设置页还没准备好，稍后再试: Settings are not ready yet. Please try again shortly.
打不开下载页: Could not open the download page
你的 Star 是对项目的支持，谢谢！: Thank you for supporting the project with a star!
打开之后，每次启动会去发布页问一句有没有比这一版新的，有新版本就弹一条提示，带一: Check the release page at startup and show a notification with a download link when an update is available. Turn off to disable automatic network checks. Enabled by default; applies at the next startup.
现在就去发布页问一句有没有比这一版新的，结果写在这一行；有新版本会再弹一条提示，: Check the release page now and show the result here. If an update is available, also show a notification with a download link. This manual check works regardless of the automatic update setting.
所有设置都在这一份 JSON 里，token 是 DPAPI 包过的: All settings are stored in this JSON file. Tokens are protected with DPAPI.
自检报告和界面树也在这儿: Also contains self-check reports and UI trees.
海报和着色器缓存，删掉不会丢设置: Poster and shader caches. Deleting them does not remove settings.
播放器右键菜单 →「截屏」存到这儿，文件名是片名、播放时间和序号: Screenshots from the player's context menu are saved here, named by title, playback time, and sequence number.
海报和剧照已经下载到本机的部分；清除后下次浏览会重新下载，不影响服务器、账号和任: Locally downloaded posters and backdrops. Clearing them downloads images again when next needed and does not affect servers, accounts, or settings.
把偏好设置（播放、字幕、画质、音频、快捷键、主题、界面等）导出成一个文件；不含服: Export playback, subtitles, picture quality, audio, shortcuts, theme, interface, and other preferences. Excludes servers, accounts, and sign-in data. Use the file on another computer or after reinstalling.
从之前备份的文件里读回偏好设置，覆盖当前这些设置。服务器、账号和登录不受影响；这: Replace current preferences with a previous backup. Servers, accounts, and sign-in are unaffected. This cannot be undone.
把设置页管的每一项改回装机时的样子。服务器、账号、登录状态和窗口位置都不动；这一: Reset every setting managed by this page. Servers, accounts, sign-in, and window position are preserved. This cannot be undone.
这份程序是哪一版、拿哪个内核在放，以及弹幕数据从哪来。: App version, playback engine, and danmaku data sources.
启动时要不要顺路问一句有没有新版本，以及现在就想知道结果时按这里。: Choose whether to check for updates at startup, or check now.
设置、日志、缓存和截图在这台机器上的位置，以及海报缓存占了多少地方。: Locations for settings, logs, cache, and screenshots, and the space used by cached images.
把偏好设置导出带走，或者从备份里读回来；恢复默认只动设置页管的那些项。: Export or restore preferences. Reset affects only settings managed by this page.
Momoka 直接连外网的两处 —— 本机整理的 TMDB 刮削、详情页的 Yo: Use this proxy for Momoka's TMDB metadata requests in local organization and YouTube trailers on details pages. Connections to your media servers and MoviePilot bypass it.
设置代理服务器地址，支持：http(s)、socks5、socks5h 等协议；: Proxy address using HTTP(S), SOCKS5, SOCKS5H, or another supported protocol. Leave blank to use the system proxy.
登录 Windows 之后要不要自动打开 Momoka。这一项改的是机器上的启动: Open Momoka automatically after signing in to Windows. Changes the system startup entry and is not stored in the settings file.
清除图片缓存失败: Could not clear the image cache

设置已改回装机时的样子。服务器、账号、窗口位置和各媒体库的排序筛选都没有动。: Settings were reset to defaults. Servers, accounts, window position, and library sorting and filters were preserved.
这个文件不是有效的配置备份: This file is not a valid preferences backup
已从备份恢复偏好设置。服务器、账号、登录状态和窗口位置都没有动。: Preferences restored from the backup. Servers, accounts, sign-in, and window position were preserved.
偏好已在本次运行应用，但尚未保存；请重试保存。: Preferences apply to this session but have not been saved. Please try saving again.
点中即生效。浅色模式下改用系统浅色配色，色板供深色模式使用；「跟随系统」随 Wi: Apply a palette immediately. Light mode uses system light colors; palettes apply in Dark mode. Follow system switches with Windows app appearance. The accent color follows the selected palette.
默认关闭。开启后使用「来源与聚合」里选择的来源；弹弹play 使用 Momoka: Off by default. Use the source selected under Sources and aggregation. DandanPlay uses Momoka's built-in credentials; danmu_api uses your self-hosted service. Search and automatic matching send the title and episode number to the selected service, never video, media-server addresses, or sign-in data.
自动匹配只接受能确认的作品与集数；danmu_api 会带年份并核对集号，弹弹p: Automatic matching accepts only confirmed titles and episodes. danmu_api checks year and episode number; DandanPlay checks season markers in sequel titles. Choose specials or uncertain matches manually during playback to avoid the wrong episode.
同时获取弹弹play 关联的第三方网站弹幕；修改后重新加载当前弹幕库。: Also retrieve third-party danmaku linked by DandanPlay. Reload the current danmaku collection after changing this.
每个人填自己部署的 danmu_api；Momoka 不提供公共服务。两者合并会: Enter your own danmu_api service; Momoka does not provide a public service. Merging requests both sources and consumes the shared DandanPlay quota.
只填服务根地址，不要带令牌；令牌在下一行单独填写。: Enter only the service root URL, without a token. Enter the token separately below.
可选。服务未启用令牌时留空；保存后不回填明文，也不进入配置备份。: Optional. Leave blank if the service does not require a token. Saved tokens are not shown in plain text or included in preference backups.
播放页的弹幕按钮和 D 快捷键可以随时开关；关闭不丢失外观与屏蔽偏好。: Toggle at any time with the player's danmaku button or D shortcut. Hiding preserves appearance and blocking preferences.
在进度条显示弹幕热力: Show danmaku heatmap on seek bar
用已加载弹幕的密度在进度条上画热力条；不额外请求弹幕服务。: Draw density from loaded danmaku without additional requests to the service.
在播放器顶部影片标题右侧显示输入栏；关闭不影响观看弹幕。: Show an input beside the title at the top of the player. Hiding it does not affect viewing danmaku.
开启时随画面高度缩放；关闭时保持固定像素字号。: Scale text with video height when enabled; otherwise use a fixed pixel size.
字幕可见时为底部预留 20% 的画面；关闭字幕后自动恢复显示区域。: Reserve the bottom 20% while subtitles are visible. Restore the display area when subtitles are off.
正常优先留出行距，较多缩小行距，重叠允许复用已占用的行；均保留同屏上限。: Normal leaves more line spacing; More reduces it; Allow overlap reuses occupied rows. All modes retain the simultaneous limit.
在本地避免弹幕相互重叠和追尾。: Locally prevent danmaku from overlapping or catching up with one another.
独立于字幕字号；缩放方式由「弹幕随窗口缩放」控制。: Independent of subtitle font size. Scaling is controlled by Scale danmaku with window.
弹幕速度同步播放倍数: Match danmaku speed to playback rate
开启时弹幕随播放倍数加速；关闭时补偿播放倍数，保持弹幕移动速度。: When enabled, danmaku accelerates with playback. When off, compensate for playback rate to keep its movement speed constant.
使用所选字体的粗体。: Use the selected font's bold weight.
描边、加粗黑边或右下方 45° 投影。: An outline, heavy black outline, or down-right 45° shadow.
25% 顶部四分之一、50% 半屏、75% 四分之三、100% 全屏。: 25%: top quarter; 50%: top half; 75%: top three quarters; 100%: full screen.
达到上限后丢弃新弹幕，不保证所有弹幕都能显示。: Discard new danmaku when the limit is reached. Some comments may not appear.
只恢复显示外观，保留来源连接、显示开关和屏蔽词。: Reset appearance only. Keep source connections, visibility, and blocked words.
显示从右向左移动的弹幕。: Show comments moving from right to left.
显示固定在顶部的弹幕。: Show comments fixed at the top.
显示固定在所选显示区域底部的弹幕。: Show comments fixed at the bottom of the selected display area.
关闭后屏蔽非白色弹幕。: Turn off to block non-white comments.
相同内容在 10 秒内只保留第一条。: Keep only the first identical comment within 10 seconds.
多个词用逗号分隔，不区分英文大小写；与播放面板共用并同步保存同一份本机列表。: Separate words with commas. Matching is case-insensitive. Uses the same locally saved list as the playback panel.
参考 B 站的显示与屏蔽设置。弹幕使用独立画面叠加层，不占用字幕轨道；支持内置播: Display and blocking options inspired by Bilibili. Danmaku uses a separate overlay, without taking a subtitle track, and supports the built-in player's integrated and standalone modes.
弹弹play 使用 Momoka 内置凭据；danmu_api 需要你自己部署并: DandanPlay uses Momoka's built-in credentials. danmu_api requires your own service address. Merging requests both sources and consumes the shared DandanPlay quota.
弹幕开关、输入栏和画面上的大小与疏密；改完立刻作用到正在播的片子。: Danmaku visibility, input, text size, and density. Changes apply immediately during playback.
哪几种弹幕显示出来，以及不想看到的词。: Choose visible comment types and blocked words.
搜索这台机器安装的字体；与字幕字体独立。: Search installed fonts. Independent of the subtitle font.
沉浸模式使用标题栏导航；商店模式使用侧边栏和居中搜索框，并立即切换电影、剧、季、: Immersive mode uses title-bar navigation. Store mode uses a sidebar and centered search, and immediately changes movie, series, season, episode, and MoviePilot details layouts. Buttons and selectors use a fixed material and hide the two groups below.
详情按钮与闭合选择框共用同一份背景；选亚克力时由下面三项染色参数决定材质。商店模: Details buttons and closed selectors share a background. Acrylic uses the three tint options below. Store mode uses a fixed material and ignores this group.
半透明叠层那层底色的 RGB；浓度在下一行。: RGB background color for the translucent layer. Strength is set below.
亚克力的 TintOpacity：染色层压得多浓，越高颜色盖得越实。: Acrylic TintOpacity: higher values produce a stronger color layer.
亚克力的 TintLuminosityOpacity：背后画面的明暗透上来多少，: Acrylic TintLuminosityOpacity controls how much underlying light and shade shows through, independently of the tint.
出厂 39.25%（那层中灰底的浓度）。0 常态完全透明，100 完全不透明；悬: Default: 39.25% for the middle-gray layer. Zero is fully transparent; 100 is opaque. Hover and pressed feedback remains.
背景图那层亚克力的染色颜色（TintColor）；换图不跟着变。: TintColor for the acrylic over the background image. Does not change with the image.
背景亚克力的 TintOpacity：染色层压得多浓。: Background acrylic TintOpacity: strength of the color layer.
背景亚克力的 TintLuminosityOpacity：图上的明暗透上来多少。: Background acrylic TintLuminosityOpacity: how much image light and shade shows through.
商店宽版式的媒体详情页右上角：背景图/预告铺这条目的剧照、环境色与渐变，有预告片: In wide Store details pages, Backdrop / trailer shows the item's image, ambient color, and gradient, and automatically plays an available trailer. Artwork removes the backdrop and gradient and shows only item artwork. Applies to movies, series, and episodes; this area is absent in narrow windows.
调整媒体库详情页的显示模式、按钮材质与背景图亚克力。: Display mode, button material, and backdrop acrylic for media details pages.
详情页正文里各块内容显示什么。: Choose the content shown on details pages.
演职人员那一排只列有头像的人；没有头像的人收起，一个都没有时这一块整块收起。关掉: List only people with photos. Hide the entire section when no photos are available. Turn off to list everyone. Applies immediately without reopening details.
拾色器、预设或六位 HEX；完成保存，取消或点击外部恢复原色。: Use the picker, presets, or six-digit HEX. Done saves; Cancel or clicking outside restores the original color.
拖拽调整顺序，取消勾选隐藏；没有内容的卡片自动收起。: Drag to reorder; clear a checkbox to hide. Cards without content hide automatically.
顺序与隐藏状态分别保存，修改后立即生效。: Order and visibility are saved separately and apply immediately.
关闭只关闭这张卡的功能，保留基础输出中的插值与算法偏好。平滑插值混合相邻帧，不做: Off disables only this card and preserves interpolation and algorithm preferences in Basic output. Smooth interpolation blends adjacent frames without motion estimation. Motion compensation uses the bundled FFmpeg CPU minterpolate filter, not GPU or AI interpolation.
自定义 mpv.conf 会在本页选项之后加载，可能覆盖补帧、同步或硬解；不保: Custom mpv.conf loads after these options and may override interpolation, synchronization, or decoding. These choices may not be the final effective values.
与基础输出共用算法偏好。使用显示同步／音频重采样，增加 GPU 渲染开销，可能产: Shares the algorithm preference with Basic output. Uses display synchronization and audio resampling, increases GPU work, and may introduce blur, ghosting, or ringing. High-frame-rate and high-refresh-rate audio-sync fallback still applies.
24–120 fps；默认 60。片源已达到目标时跳过，不为了补帧丢弃原有高帧率: 24–120 fps; default 60. Skip when the source already reaches the target; never discard high-rate source frames just to interpolate.
质量与速度取舍，不是实测性能评级。高档启用边界处的小块运动补偿；高分辨率与高目标: A quality/speed tradeoff, not a measured performance rating. High quality adds small-block compensation at edges. High resolutions and targets may exceed real-time speed; lower the target or prefer speed if playback stutters.
CPU 运动补偿增加 CPU 负载、内存复制和延迟，只处理 8-bit SDR: CPU motion compensation increases CPU load, memory copies, and latency, and handles only 8-bit SDR. Recognized HDR or high-bit-depth sources are skipped. SVP is an optional external component with its own algorithm and target controls. Both may introduce motion artifacts; real-time speed and HDR preservation are not guaranteed.
默认关闭，需自行安装并运行 SVP Manager。算法、目标帧率和可选 RIF: Off by default. Install and run SVP Manager separately. Configure its algorithm, target frame rate, and optional RIFE model there. Turning off restores this card's preferences. Applies to the next playback.
自定义 mpv.conf 可能安装其他滤镜／脚本，首版不与 SVP 同时接管。关: Custom mpv.conf may install other filters or scripts, so it cannot run together with SVP in this version. Disable custom configuration to restore SVP integration. Both preferences and the path are preserved.
当前使用自定义 mpv.conf，SVP 不接入: Custom mpv.conf is active; SVP is not used
留空自动查找，或填写 VSScript.dll 的完整路径: Leave blank to locate automatically, or enter the full path to VSScript.dll
只接受本机 x64 VSScript.dll。SVP 安装器中的 mpv／Vap: Requires a local x64 VSScript.dll and complete mpv/VapourSynth components from the SVP installer. Set up Python according to SVP's instructions, then restart Momoka.
仅确认本地 x64 文件存在，不代表 Python／滤镜已加载或 SVP 已连接: Only confirms that a local x64 file exists, not that Python or filters loaded or SVP connected. Run SVP Manager first and confirm takeover there after playback starts.
缺少可用组件，SVP 播放暂不可用: Required component missing; SVP playback is unavailable
算法、目标帧率、质量与可选 RIFE 模型在 SVP Manager 中管理。本: Manage the algorithm, target frame rate, quality, and optional RIFE model in SVP Manager. Playback uses copy-back or software decoding, audio synchronization, and no other Momoka interpolation, while preserving preferences. Switching items rebuilds the video window. If another player owns mpvpipe, playback stops with a message instead of connecting to that player.
在 Momoka 主页的媒体库那一排使用内置封面风格；关闭后恢复原封面，不修改服: Use built-in cover styles for Home library shortcuts. Turn off to restore original covers. Server images are never modified.
全部媒体库入口使用同一套风格，切换后立即生效。: Apply one style to all library shortcuts immediately.
仅替换主页媒体库那一排的封面显示。: Replace only the cover display of Home library shortcuts.
留空时使用截图保存目录: Leave blank to use the screenshot folder
片段、动图与字幕文件存到这里。留空使用截图保存目录。: Save clips, animations, and subtitle files here. Leave blank to use the screenshot folder.
留空时查找 ffmpeg 同目录的 ffprobe.exe: Leave blank to find ffprobe.exe beside ffmpeg
ffsubsync 与 alass 可任选一种；按音轨同步还需要 ffmpeg: Choose ffsubsync or alass. Synchronizing against audio also requires ffmpeg and ffprobe.
使用兼容 faster-whisper-xxl 参数的独立程序，从当前片段的音频: Generate subtitles from the current clip's audio using a standalone program compatible with faster-whisper-xxl arguments.
小模型更快，大模型占用更多内存。首次使用可能由识别程序下载模型。: Smaller models are faster; larger models use more memory. The recognition program may download the model on first use.
CPU 通用；CUDA 需要识别程序支持的 NVIDIA 显卡与驱动。: CPU works generally; CUDA requires an NVIDIA GPU and driver supported by the recognition program.
自动识别由语音识别程序判断。: Automatic detection is performed by the speech recognition program.
为播放器右键菜单中的片段与动图导出选择本机工具。配置自动保存，下一次操作使用新值: Choose local tools for clips and animated exports in the player's context menu. Changes save automatically and apply to the next operation.
用本机工具校准字幕时间。选择工具只检查文件，不启动同步。: Adjust subtitle timing using local tools. Selecting a tool only checks the file and does not start synchronization.
通过本机语音识别程序为片段生成字幕。识别参数在选好程序后显示。: Generate clip subtitles with a local speech recognition program. Recognition options appear after choosing the program.
填写绝对路径，可直接粘贴资源管理器的“复制为路径”。: Enter an absolute path. You can paste Copy as path from File Explorer.
找到文件只表示路径可用，不代表工具版本兼容。: A found file confirms only that the path is available, not that the tool version is compatible.
未配置可用的字幕同步工具: No usable subtitle synchronization tool configured
；音轨参考还需要 ffmpeg 与 ffprobe: ; audio reference also requires ffmpeg and ffprobe
选择播放工具失败: Could not select the playback tool
试试操作名称或按键，如「字幕」「Ctrl + ↑」；清空搜索可查看全部。: Search an action or key, such as Subtitles or Ctrl + ↑. Clear the search to show all shortcuts.
恢复全部快捷键，包括当前搜索未显示的项目；其他设置不受影响: Reset all shortcuts, including hidden search results. Other settings are unaffected.
播放时的键盘快捷键。点右边方框后按键即可改绑，可带 Ctrl / Alt / S: Keyboard shortcuts during playback. Click a box and press a key, optionally with Ctrl, Alt, or Shift. Conflicting bindings can be replaced after confirmation. × clears a binding. Applies only in the playback window.
绑定状态已更新，请重新录制后再确认替换。: The binding changed. Record it again before confirming replacement.
快捷键已在本次运行恢复默认，但尚未保存。: Shortcuts were reset for this session but have not been saved.
播放器快捷键已恢复默认。其他设置没有动。: Playback shortcuts reset to defaults. Other settings were preserved.
开启后把正在显示的文字字幕逐句发送给所选服务；需要 API 密钥，可能按量收费。: Send each displayed text-subtitle line to the selected service. An API key is required and usage may be billed. Keep the original subtitles and show translations in a separate layer. This is not speech recognition; it cannot translate missing text or bitmap subtitles such as PGS/VOBSUB.
谷歌、微软需要各自的云翻译 API；AI 使用兼容 OpenAI 的接口，不会读: Google and Microsoft require their cloud translation APIs. AI uses an OpenAI-compatible API and does not read browser sign-in.
自动识别由翻译服务判断；混合语言字幕可以手动指定。: Automatic detection is performed by the translation service. Choose manually for mixed-language subtitles.
已经是目标语言的台词仍可能计入服务用量；只翻译当前选择并显示的主字幕。: Lines already in the target language may still count toward usage. Only the selected, displayed primary subtitles are translated.
默认使用 Google Cloud Translation v2。需要启用云翻译: Defaults to Google Cloud Translation v2. Enable the Cloud Translation API and restrict the key's APIs and quota.
默认使用 Azure AI Translator v3。选择与资源对应的端点。: Defaults to Azure AI Translator v3. Choose the endpoint for your resource.
例如 eastasia；全局资源可留空: For example, eastasia; leave blank for a global resource
区域必须与 Azure Translator 资源一致；多服务资源通常需要填写。: Must match the Azure Translator resource. Multi-service resources normally require a region.
填写兼容 OpenAI 的服务基址（含 /v1），不填 /chat/comple: Enter an OpenAI-compatible base URL including /v1, without /chat/completions. HTTPS only; local models may use HTTP loopback addresses. Subtitles are sent here, so choose a trusted service.
填写该服务支持的模型名称。AI 翻译通常延迟和费用更高，不保证每句都能在消失前返: Enter a model supported by the service. AI translation usually has higher latency and cost, and may not return every line before it disappears.
独立于原字幕字号，按画面高度缩放。: Independent of the original subtitle font size; scales with video height.
越大越靠下。默认放在原字幕上方；与原字幕重叠时向上调整。: Higher values place text lower. Defaults above the original subtitles. Move up if they overlap.
把正在显示的文字字幕逐句翻成另一种语言。自动保存，开关、服务与外观立即应用到当前: Translate displayed text subtitles line by line. Saves automatically and applies enabled state, service, and appearance immediately. Keep at most 256 lines in memory, clear them when switching items, and never save source or translation files.
连哪个翻译服务、用哪种语言、密钥存哪儿。地址随所选服务变化；密钥只保存在本机。: Choose the translation service, languages, and API keys. Endpoint options follow the selected service; keys stay on this computer.
译文自己一层，字号和位置都不跟原字幕走。: Translations use their own layer, font size, and position.
自动保存，下次播放生效。: Saves automatically; applies to the next playback.
集成模式在主窗口播放，固定使用 Direct3D 11。独占模式使用单独的视频窗: Integrated mode plays in the main window and uses Direct3D 11. Standalone mode uses a separate video window and selectable graphics API, while keeping libraries accessible. Closing the video window stops playback.
通常使用 GPU-Next；遇到兼容问题可尝试 GPU。外部 mpv 使用本页设: Usually GPU-Next. Try GPU for compatibility issues. External mpv uses these options and does not read mpv.conf.
集成模式固定使用 D3D11；切换到独占模式后可选择其他接口。: Integrated mode always uses D3D11. Other APIs are available in standalone mode.
默认 Vulkan。若无法播放或画面异常，可尝试自动或 Direct3D 11；: Default: Vulkan. Try Auto or Direct3D 11 if playback fails or the image is incorrect. Performance depends on the GPU and driver.
推荐自动（复制回内存），兼顾硬解与滤镜兼容性。原生硬解的开销较低，但受显卡、图形: Automatic copy-back is recommended for hardware decoding and filter compatibility. Native hardware decoding has less overhead but depends on the GPU, API, and filters. Software decoding is attempted if hardware decoding is unavailable. Turn off if the image is incorrect.
SVP 接入时使用音频同步；关闭 SVP 后恢复原有同步偏好。: SVP uses audio synchronization. Turning SVP off restores the saved sync preference.
与显示设备的输入范围保持一致。电脑显示器通常选全范围；范围不匹配会造成灰黑或暗部: Match the display's input range. PC monitors normally use Full. A mismatch produces gray blacks or lost shadow detail.
用于消除隔行视频运动边缘的梳齿。老电视片源可选自动；普通逐行视频保持关闭。: Remove combing around motion in interlaced video. Auto may suit older television sources. Keep off for normal progressive video.
本次补帧交给 SVP；相邻帧混合关闭，保存的插值偏好保留。: SVP handles interpolation for this playback. Adjacent-frame blending is disabled, but its preference is preserved.
本次播放使用补帧的运动补偿，相邻帧混合已关闭；在「补帧」卡切回其他模式后可选择插: Motion compensation is active and adjacent-frame blending is disabled. Choose another mode in Frame interpolation to make this option available.
本次播放由「补帧」卡的平滑插值启用相邻帧混合，算法在那张卡里选；这里不改保存的插: Smooth interpolation enables adjacent-frame blending. Choose its algorithm in Frame interpolation. The saved preference here is preserved.
音频同步下插值关闭；切换视频同步后可选择插值。: Interpolation is disabled with audio synchronization. Choose another synchronization mode to enable it.
混合相邻帧以减轻顿挫，不生成运动补偿帧。过采样偏清晰；Mitchell 兼顾清晰: Blend adjacent frames to reduce judder without motion compensation. Oversampling favors sharpness; Mitchell balances sharpness and smoothness; bicubic is smoother and softer. Blending may cause ghosting, and Mitchell may cause ringing at moving edges.
高帧率或高刷新率时使用音频同步: Use audio sync at high frame or refresh rates
片源超过 47 fps，或屏幕刷新率超过设定阈值时，停用插值并改用音频同步，以降: Disable interpolation and switch to audio synchronization above 47 source fps or the configured display refresh threshold, reducing rendering overhead.
播放开始时，屏幕刷新率超过此值就改用音频同步。即使未启用插值，也会影响显示同步。: Switch to audio synchronization when the display refresh rate exceeds this value at playback startup. Also affects display synchronization without interpolation.
宽于 16:9 的片源裁切填充: Crop sources wider than 16:9 to fill
放大宽银幕画面以减少黑边，部分画面和贴边字幕可能被裁掉。播放时也可在菜单中临时调: Enlarge widescreen video to reduce black bars. Some image content and edge subtitles may be cropped. Also adjustable temporarily in the playback menu.
在输出时加入细微噪点，减少位深转换产生的色带。继承预设时，是否启用由预设决定。: Add fine noise at output to reduce banding from bit-depth conversion. Inherit preset lets the preset decide.
通常选自动；手动值应与实际输出位深匹配，不会改变显示器的硬件位深。: Auto is normally best. Manual values should match the actual output depth and do not change the display hardware's bit depth.
平滑渐变中的色阶断层，可能损失细节。着色器的老片源修复生效时，会替代这里的处理。: Smooth color steps in gradients, possibly losing detail. Shader restoration for older sources replaces this processing when active.
越高越容易抹掉纹理和颗粒。只控制内置去色带，不影响着色器的老片源修复。: Higher values remove more texture and grain. Controls built-in debanding only, not shader restoration for older sources.
亮度单位为 nits，不会直接调整显示器背光。: Luminance is measured in nits and does not directly change monitor backlight brightness.
HDR 输出要求系统和显示器支持 HDR；不支持时由内核映射。不是电视原生杜比视: HDR output requires operating-system and display support; otherwise the engine tone-maps it. This is not native Dolby Vision passthrough to a TV.
自动使用显示器上报或内核推定值。手动按屏幕实际峰值填写，例如 600 或 100: Auto uses the display-reported or engine-estimated value. Enter the display's actual peak manually, such as 600 or 1000. This limit does not apply when mapping to SDR.
处理超过目标亮度的高光。自动或 Spline 适合先试；不会再强制截断高光。: Handle highlights above the target luminance. Start with Auto or Spline. Highlights are no longer forcibly clipped.
按画面估算亮度而不只信任片源元数据；需要额外 GPU 算力。: Estimate brightness from the image rather than trusting source metadata alone. Requires extra GPU processing.
控制 HDR 环境中的普通白色与 SDR 内容亮度，不是高光上限。自动跟随系统；: Control ordinary white and SDR content brightness in HDR, not the highlight ceiling. Auto follows the system; also affects the mapping target for SDR output.
自动跟随参考白；文字字幕和屏幕控件过亮时可单独降低。不改变视频亮度。: Auto follows reference white. Reduce separately if text subtitles or controls are too bright. Video brightness is unaffected.
PGS、VobSub 等图像字幕单独控制。自动保留内核默认（当前 1000）；过: Separate control for image subtitles such as PGS and VobSub. Auto preserves the engine default (currently 1000); try 203 if too bright.
自动继承画质预设；手动范围 0–2，越高局部对比越强，也可能产生光晕。: Auto inherits the quality preset. Manual range: 0–2. Higher values increase local contrast and may create halos.
默认开启，使用片源的 RPU 信息进行色彩处理。关闭仅供有兼容基础层的片源排障；: On by default. Use source RPU data for color processing. Disable only to troubleshoot a compatible base layer. Disabling Profile 5 may distort colors and does not provide HDR10 fallback.
默认开启。只有内核和解码路径实际提供增强层时才有效；开关不代表所有 Profil: On by default. Effective only when the engine and decoding path provide the enhancement layer. This switch does not imply full support for every Profile 7 FEL source.
默认保留动态元数据供播放器映射；不代表向电视原样发送 HDR10+。: Preserve dynamic metadata for player tone-mapping by default. Does not mean unchanged HDR10+ is sent to a TV.
按系统显示器配置校色。明确选择 HDR 输出或 HDR 转 SDR 时，本次 H: Use the system display profile. Explicit HDR output or HDR-to-SDR mode takes priority for HDR playback so ICC cannot override the output target.
亮度按整数 nits 保存，小数四舍五入。: Luminance is saved as integer nits; fractions are rounded.
先应用预设，再应用视频设置，最后应用着色器链的前置参数。fast 在加载较重着色: Apply the preset, then video options, then shader-chain pre-options. Fast does not guarantee low overhead when heavy shaders are loaded.
默认关闭。开启后按显示器全屏目标、片源类型和显卡档位选链；拖动或全屏切换不反复换: Off by default. Choose a chain from fullscreen resolution, source type, and GPU tier. Resizing and fullscreen transitions do not repeatedly switch chains, avoiding compilation stutters.
决定链的复杂度，不是自动测出的性能评级。集成管线固定 D3D11，动画 CNN: Controls chain complexity, not an automatically measured performance rating. Integrated mode uses D3D11 and animation CNN chains are heavy. Standalone mode supports other APIs. Lower the tier or disable shaders if playback stutters.
这里保存长期偏好；Anime4K 为固定柔化修复链，不替换自动 ArtCNN。高: Save a persistent preference. Anime4K is a fixed soft-restoration chain and does not replace automatic ArtCNN. High resolutions or frame rates may stutter. Use the player's shader menu for temporary comparisons without changing this preference.
按 Emby 类型与标签匹配当前关键词：: Match the following keywords in Emby genres and tags:
。命中后按下方选择使用动画链或 Anime4K，手动指定的档位优先。: . Matching sources use the animation chain or Anime4K selected below. A manually selected profile takes priority.
识别为动画的片源改用 Anime4K 柔化修复链（Krig + Restore: Use the fixed Anime4K soft-restoration chain (Krig + Restore Soft M + Clamp + SSim) for animation instead of selecting ArtCNN by scale. The chain does not change with GPU tier, old-source restoration, or frame rate. High rates or scaling factors may stutter more than the automatic chain. A manual profile still takes priority.
高度不超过 576 的片源增加 hdeband；中高档再增加降噪。会代替上方内置: Add hdeband for sources no taller than 576 pixels, plus denoising on medium and high tiers. Replaces built-in debanding and may remove grain or detail. Does not add processing to the fixed Anime4K chain.
宽 ≥7000 或高 ≥3000 时不自动加载任何链，避免 GPU 过载。: Do not load an automatic chain at width ≥7000 or height ≥3000 to avoid GPU overload.
预设与着色器开关相互独立。: Presets and shader enablement are independent.
默认跟随 Windows 显示语言：中文系统使用简体中文，其他语言使用英语。修改: Follow the Windows display language: use Simplified Chinese for Chinese systems and English otherwise. Restart Momoka to apply changes.
随 Windows 的浅色或深色应用模式自动切换。: Switch automatically with the Windows light or dark app mode.
深邃的蓝黑底色，配以柔和薄荷绿。: Deep blue-black surfaces with soft mint-green accents.
面全部压到黑，给 OLED 和全暗的房间。: Black surfaces for OLED displays and dark rooms.
偏蓝的深色面配亮蓝强调色。: Blue-tinted dark surfaces with bright-blue accents.
中性灰的面配琥珀色强调色，海报的颜色不被主题抢。: Neutral gray surfaces with amber accents that let posters stand out.
偏紫的深色面配淡紫强调色。: Purple-tinted dark surfaces with pale-purple accents.
